svg.title: done-means-seen
svg.desc: A terminal. Claude says the settings page is done. The Stop hook runs the typecheck, finds an error and sends Claude back to work: the andon light turns red. Claude fixes it (amber), the check turns green, and Claude reports done again, this time having saved a value, reloaded the page and seen it stick. Footer: rule 1, "done" means I have seen it work.
svg.text: A STOP HOOK FOR CLAUDE CODE ]

g.text: Done! The settings page now saves the user's timezone.
ERROR: the check for web-app fails after your changes.
src/settings.ts(4,9): Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'Timezone'.
FIX: read the output, fix the cause, hand back. (block 1 of 3)
The select returned a string. Parsing it into a Timezone.
Done, and seen: saved "Europe/Paris" on /settings, reloaded, it stuck.

svg.text: “DONE” MEANS I HAVE SEEN IT WORK.
